from pathlib import Path
import sys,types,json,time,numpy as np
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(p.parent/'rain-reduced-trust-reference'))
import reduced_model as r
from wave import wave
m=r.m
# Adapt the prior independently checked fixed-bound QP implementation to the exact reduced equations.
blocks=[]
for b in r.blocks:
 d=dict(b['original']);ii=b['indices'];assert np.array_equal(ii,np.arange(ii[0],ii[-1]+1));d.update(sl=slice(int(ii[0]),int(ii[-1]+1)),step=b['step'],normal_indices=b['normal_indices']);blocks.append(d)
proxy=types.SimpleNamespace(p=p,H=r.S,g=r.q,old=m.old[r.remaining],offset=r.N,E=r.E,blocks=blocks,radius=m.radius,residual=r.residual)
source=(m.p/'structured.py').read_text().split("start=time.monotonic();termination=''")[0].replace('import model as m','')
results={}
for name,start_state in [('cold',np.zeros(r.N)),('capped',proxy.old.copy())]:
 arm=p/name;arm.mkdir(exist_ok=True);proxy.p=arm
 ns={'m':proxy};exec(compile(source,'parent-structured-definition','exec'),ns)
 evaluate=ns['evaluate'];normal_indices=ns['normal_indices'];start=time.monotonic();termination=''
 try:
  root=ns['anderson'](evaluate,start_state[normal_indices],M=5,maxiter=32,f_tol=1e-9,line_search='armijo');termination='anderson-reported-convergence';evaluate(root)
 except (ns['NoConvergence'],ns['Budget'],ns['InnerFailure']) as e:termination=type(e).__name__
 records=ns['records'];states=ns['states'];assert states
 # Selection uses original full residual, not only the numerically rescaled reduced map.
 full_residuals=[float(np.max(abs(m.residual(r.recover(y)))/(1+abs(r.recover(y))))) for y in states]
 best=int(np.argmin(full_residuals));x=r.recover(states[best]);initial=full_residuals[best];newton=[];polish_termination='eight-step-cap'
 for iteration in range(8):
  residual=m.residual(x);natural=float(np.max(abs(residual)/(1+abs(x))))
  if natural<=1e-10:polish_termination='strict-natural-residual';break
  D=m.residual(x,True);dx,_,rank,s=np.linalg.lstsq(D,-residual,rcond=1e-12);merit=float(residual@residual);accepted=False
  for backtrack in range(8):
   alpha=2.**-backtrack;trial=x+alpha*dx;rt=m.residual(trial)
   if rt@rt<=(1-1e-4*alpha)*merit:accepted=True;break
  newton.append(dict(iteration=iteration+1,natural=natural,rank=int(rank),linear_residual=float(np.max(abs(D@dx+residual))),accepted=accepted,step=alpha if accepted else 0.,backtracks=backtrack))
  if not accepted:polish_termination='line-search-failed';break
  x=trial
 natural=float(np.max(abs(m.residual(x))/(1+abs(x))));grad=m.gradient_primal(x);dense=m.H@x+m.g;agreement=float(np.max(abs(grad-dense)/(1+np.maximum(abs(grad),abs(dense)))));_,sweep=wave(x);feas=[]
 for b in m.blocks:
  val=x[b['sl']];domain=b['domain'];cap=m.radius(b,x);error=0.
  if domain=='positive':error=max(0,-float(min(val)))
  elif domain=='box':error=max(0,float(max(abs(val)))-cap)/(1+cap)
  elif domain=='ball':error=max(0,float(np.linalg.norm(val))-cap)/(1+cap)
  feas.append(error)
 passed=bool(natural<=1e-8 and max(feas)<=1e-8 and agreement<=1e-9 and max(sweep['max_velocity_change'],sweep['max_impulse_change'])<=1e-5)
 output=dict(status='reference-pass' if passed else 'reference-failed',seconds=time.monotonic()-start,structured_termination=termination,qp_calls=len(records),selected_call=best+1,structured_original_natural_residual=initial,polish_termination=polish_termination,newton=newton,final_original_relative_natural_residual=natural,maximum_scaled_feasibility_violation=max(feas),direct_primal_agreement=agreement,original_colored_wave=sweep,qp_records=records,full_residuals=full_residuals)
 np.savez(arm/'solution.npz',impulses=x,velocities=m.vfree+m.M@m.J.T@x);results[name]=output;(p/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2));print('ARM',name,json.dumps({k:v for k,v in output.items() if k not in ['qp_records','full_residuals']}),flush=True)
if not all(x['status']=='reference-pass' for x in results.values()):raise SystemExit(1)
